generatedFrom: Curated by the F8 implementation from the published packages and their pinned upstream commits; verified by pnpm notices:check.
policy: The generator reads license and notice files from the real package sources.
An override is used only when the published package ships no license text at all; each names the exact upstream commit and is digest-checked.
Canonical texts come from the SPDX license-list-data v3.29.0 release and are used only where upstream ships a licensing statement but no text.
No dependency version is pinned here: an override whose version is absent from the locked graph is stale and fails the check.
